about: Compiler options (and option values) that the TypeScript 7 native compiler rejects. Used by lib/tsgo/fit.mjs for rules tc-01 (and tc-02 for baseUrl). Every entry was run against tsc 7.0.2 (native) on 2026-10-20; `ts7.code` / `ts7.message` are the observed diagnostic. `ts6` is the same option on tsc 6.0.3, `ts5_9` on tsc 5.9.3 where it differs in a way that matters. Attribution matters (doc 08 defect 7): the group `removed-in-5.5` was removed by TypeScript 5.5, not by TS 7. `scratch_override` is the value fit writes into a temporary tsconfig (under .ts-optimize/fit/, deleted afterwards, `null` = unset the inherited option) so the native compiler can type-check a project whose configuration it otherwise refuses to look past: tsc 7.0.2 stops after the TS51xx/TS5023 configuration errors without type-checking (observed on fixture F08). Timings and diagnostics taken from that scratch run are labelled as such; the project's files are never modified.
match_semantics: `match.values`: option value compared case-insensitively as a string; `match.value`: strict equality (booleans); `match.any`: the key being present at all is the error. Option names are matched case-insensitively.

ignore_deprecations.ts6: On TS 6.0 `"ignoreDeprecations": "6.0"` silences the TS5101/TS5107 deprecation errors (observed on 6.0.3: no output for target=es5 with it set).
ignore_deprecations.ts7: TS 7.0.2 accepts `ignoreDeprecations` ("6.0" and "7.0" produced no diagnostic of their own) but it no longer silences anything: TS5102/TS5108 are still reported for the same options (observed).
ignore_deprecations.removed_in_5_5: The `removed-in-5.5` options already fail on tsc 5.9.3 and 6.0.3 with TS5102; no ignoreDeprecations value silences them (observed).

ts7.message: Option 'target=ES5' has been removed. Please remove it from your configuration.

ts6.message: Option 'target=ES5' is deprecated and will stop functioning in TypeScript 7.0. Specify compilerOption '"ignoreDeprecations": "6.0"' to silence this error.

entries.remedy: Set "target" to ES2022 (applications) or ES2020 (libraries that must reach older runtimes). Legacy-browser output belongs to a transpiler (SWC, esbuild, Babel), not tsc.
source: TS 7.0 announcement: `target: es5` is no longer supported

ts6.message: Option 'target=ES3' has been removed. Please remove it from your configuration.

entries.remedy: Set "target" to ES2022 or ES2020. ES3 is not a valid value in TS 7 (invalid-argument error, not a deprecation).

entries.remedy: "bundler" for bundled applications (with module esnext/preserve); "nodenext" (with module nodenext) for Node ESM/CJS libraries, which requires explicit .js extensions in relative imports. `node` is an alias of `node10` and is reported the same way.

ts7.message: Option 'module=AMD' has been removed. Please remove it from your configuration.
ts7.message_note: AMD, UMD, System in the message; TS5095 (moduleResolution 'bundler' implied by the new default module setting) may accompany it when moduleResolution is unset.

ts6.message: Option 'module=AMD' is deprecated and will stop functioning in TypeScript 7.0. Specify compilerOption '"ignoreDeprecations": "6.0"' to silence this error.

entries.remedy: "module": "esnext" (or "preserve" for bundlers) for applications, "nodenext" for Node packages.

ts6.message_note: `none` is deprecated on 6.0.3 (TS5107); `systemjs` was never a valid value (TS6046 on both; the valid name is `system`).

entries.remedy: Same as module amd/umd/system. These values are now rejected as invalid arguments (TS6046), not as removals.
source: TS 7.0 announcement: `module: amd, umd, systemjs, none` are no longer supported
